title: Specification of the emitted AND circuit
statement: For every natural number $n$, consider the circuit obtained by recursively combining the input vertices $0,1,dots,n-1$ with AND, starting from an empty gate list, and let $r$ be its gate list and output vertex. The gate list extends the empty list and is acyclic, and the output vertex is less than $n$ plus the number of gates; on every Boolean input assignment, the output equals the AND of all input values. The number of gates is at most the tree cost of $n$, and the output depth is at most $\lceil\log_2 n\rceil+1$. Every gate in the emitted list has AND kind, has distinct input vertices, and has at most two inputs.
